scope: Reachable Git patch history, current changes, detector candidates, local browser bundle, dependency audits and automated authorization tests; no deployed-service claim
candidate_review: Keyword/basic-auth matches were reviewed as test credentials, placeholders or a malformed http://mailto email link in public Polymer job HTML. Entropy detectors also match public payload digests, lockfile integrity and native public metadata; an entropy match is not a confirmed credential. This is not proof that every possible secret form is absent.
remaining_review: Hosted proxy trust, platform secrets/logs/caching, notification delivery and provider OAuth/SMTP are deferred with production. Trusted Types is report-only until framework sinks are fully verified.
